sections.name: [mcu]
sections.description: Configuration of the primary micro-controller

parameters.name: serial

parameters.name: canbus_uuid

parameters.name: restart_method
parameters.description: Mechanism the host uses to reset the micro-controller.

sections.name: [printer]
sections.description: High level printer settings including kinematics

parameters.name: kinematics
parameters.description: Type of printer kinematics in use.

parameters.name: minimum_cruise_ratio
parameters.description: Minimum cruising distance ratio to reduce top speed of short zigzag moves.

parameters.name: square_corner_velocity
parameters.description: Maximum velocity (mm/s) the toolhead may travel a 90 degree corner at.

parameters.name: max_z_velocity
parameters.description: Maximum velocity (mm/s) of Z axis movement. Kinematics-specific.

parameters.name: max_z_accel
parameters.description: Maximum acceleration (mm/s^2) of Z axis movement. Kinematics-specific.

delta.name: minimum_z_position
delta.description: Minimum Z position user may command.

delta.name: delta_radius
delta.description: Radius (mm) of horizontal circle formed by three linear axis towers.

rotary_delta.name: shoulder_radius
rotary_delta.description: Radius (mm) of horizontal circle formed by shoulder joints minus effector joints.

rotary_delta.description: Distance (mm) of shoulder joints from bed minus effector toolhead height.

sections.name: [stepper_x]
sections.pattern: stepper_x / stepper_y / stepper_z / stepper_a / stepper_b / stepper_c
sections.description: Stepper motor definitions. Names depend on kinematics type.

parameters.name: enable_pin
parameters.description: Enable pin (default enable high; use ! for enable low).

parameters.name: rotation_distance
parameters.description: Distance (mm) axis travels with one full rotation of stepper motor.

parameters.name: microsteps
parameters.description: Number of microsteps the stepper motor driver uses.

parameters.name: full_steps_per_rotation
parameters.description: Full steps for one rotation (200 for 1.8°, 400 for 0.9°).

parameters.name: gear_ratio
parameters.description: Gear ratio if connected via gearbox. E.g. '5:1' or '57:11, 2:1'.

parameters.name: step_pulse_duration
parameters.description: Minimum time between step pulse signal edge and unstep signal edge.

parameters.name: endstop_pin
parameters.description: Endstop switch detection pin. Required for X, Y, Z on cartesian.

parameters.name: position_min
parameters.description: Minimum valid distance (mm) user may command stepper to move to.

parameters.name: position_endstop
parameters.description: Location of the endstop (mm). Required for X, Y, Z on cartesian.

parameters.name: position_max
parameters.description: Maximum valid distance (mm) user may command stepper to move to. Required for X, Y, Z on cartesian.

parameters.name: homing_speed
parameters.description: Maximum velocity (mm/s) of stepper when homing.

parameters.name: homing_retract_dist
parameters.description: Distance (mm) to backoff before homing a second time. 0 = disable second home.

parameters.name: homing_retract_speed
parameters.description: Speed for retract move after homing.

parameters.name: second_homing_speed
parameters.description: Velocity (mm/s) of stepper when performing second home.

parameters.name: homing_positive_dir
parameters.description: If true, home in positive direction.

sections.name: [bed_mesh]
sections.description: Mesh bed leveling. Offsets Z axis based on mesh generated from probed points.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: Speed (mm/s) of non-probing moves during calibration.

parameters.name: horizontal_move_z
parameters.description: Height (mm) to move to before probe operation.

parameters.name: mesh_origin

parameters.name: mesh_max
parameters.description: Maximum X,Y coordinate of mesh for rectangular beds. Required for rectangular.

parameters.name: probe_count
parameters.description: Number of points to probe along each axis (X, Y).

parameters.description: Maximum points along each axis for round beds. Must be odd.

parameters.name: fade_start
parameters.description: Z position to start phasing out z-adjustment.
